  'binary(cli_send) | binary(cli_verify)'`). Per architecture · established-decisions/decision/screen-signatures-
  compiled as the founder's Q2 rewords it (`inputs#I4`).

- (clauses) `option_shape_reads_each_clause_boundary`, `option_shape_a_shaped_label_with_the_box_below_still_refuses`,
  `box_below_a_quoted_label_without_the_box_below_still_refuses` and `quoted_label_with_the_box_below_reads_ready` pass.

  numbering; the label ending the row; the box's own rows strictly below; a footer alone never the box (`inputs#I3`
  items 4, 5).
- (gate tier) The two `wait_ready_verified_…` cases of steps 12–13 pass (`bash scripts/agent-run.sh run --unit`).

- (controls) Each of `shape-off`, `shape-off-e2e`, `below-off` and `raw-presence` reads `holds`, and each named case
  FAILED in its removed log (implement's one-shot `gate.py control`, step 17). Per test-plan · test-strategy/
  decision/bounded-remove-the-guard-witness.

- (verify, no stamp moves) Every stamped recorded set stamps with zero fails over the fake agent, with no recording
  start (`bash scripts/agent-run.sh run --e2e --filter 'binary(contract_ledger_probes) | …'`). Per test-plan ·
  integration-test-strategy/decision/ledger-probe-contract-suite and `inputs#I3` item 7.

- (preservation) No committed fixture, schema, core word, ledger row or fake-agent option changes (the `gate.py guard`
  entry reads `guard: clean`).

- (feed panic) A caught vt100 feed panic still refuses `input-not-ready`, passthrough kept (`chaos_feed_panic_refuses_
  send_and_keeps_passthrough`, in the e2e filter entry). Per security-plan · input-validation/decision/vt100-feed-
  under-panic-catch.

- (tests) `bash scripts/agent-run.sh run --integration` and `bash scripts/agent-run.sh run --e2e` return `"ok":true`.
  CI on the pushed HEAD reads `verdict: green` (`python -X utf8 ~/.claude/skills/andromeda-tools/scripts/ci.py
  conclusion --sha HEAD --wait 1800`).

- No capability of the version's ledger is claimed. None in the pool names a gate reading, and the taken-up entry
  carries no `CARRY: proves`.

- External: `inputs#I1` (the directive), `inputs#I2` (the take-up invocation), `inputs#I3` (the P3 relay: the
  founder's answers and the technical answers), `inputs#I4` (the answered forks), `inputs#I5` (this resume's
  invocation).

- (B) box below alone, (C) option shape alone, (D) (A) widened by selector adjacency — declined by the founder
  (`inputs#I4` Q1). (B) releases the suite's synthetic box-below offer; (C) is the dangerous side.

- Cell attributes, the dialog's frame or title as a discriminator — set aside: no recorded screen keeps them, and
  proving them needs a live start (`inputs#I4`, the block).

- Reading the session transcript to tell a quote from a modal — rejected: outside obs-plan · 11-obs-anti-patterns-
  never-do-these/decision/transcripts-not-a-contract's one exception.

- A new fake-agent option for the quoting screen — not needed: the scratch copy's ready screen carries it (step 15),
  and the fake's closed option list stays at its bound.

- Moving verify's settle end or `first_screen` onto the new predicate — rejected: neither decides a byte typed into a
  transcript screen (`inputs#I3` item 7).

- A new refusal detail, log line, span field or hint for a quoted label — none: the gate reads it as ready, and a
  standing modal keeps `input-not-ready` (obs-plan · 4-span-trace-coverage/decision/browser-tools-prompt-reading-
  uninstrumented).

- A committed screen fixture holding a transcript row — never: synthetic screens are built in the test (test-plan ·
  7-test-data-fixtures/decision/synthetic-fixture-text).

- Moving a case's expected verdict to get past a red, or any bound or assertion of the WATCH — never (`inputs#I1`
  item 1).

- No live start, no scheduled-wake or timer tool, nothing read under the operator's real `~/.claude*` (`inputs#I1`,
  `inputs#I3` item 8).

- **The measured shape.** The 10:22 defect followed a P5 card printed in the driven session's chat (`chunks/
  2026-11-19-the-2-1-328-recorded-fixture-set/inputs/I3-relay-fixture-328-p5-review.md.txt`). That card is the sealed
  `2026-11-19T09-28-18Z-phase/p5-card-1.md`. Its one literal-bearing line (line 27) holds the trust label inside an
  inline code span, mid-sentence, with a `"` directly before and after it: 48 characters before it, 41 after. Basis:
  `rec.py unpack` of that run into the session scratchpad, then a shape-only read that printed classes, never text.
  The label's first word is joined to the opening `"`, so however the TUI wraps the line, the row holding the whole

## The block

**Window.** This window holds Setup, P1 (promoted, tx 3304), P2 (the row read: 775 of 4752 rows picked, 7 history

**The cause, as read in the code — the overseer's hypothesis confirmed.** `Screen::verdict`
(`crates/viola-agent-claude/src/screen.rs:330-359`) refuses `input-not-ready` as soon as ANY visible row CONTAINS a
modal label as a substring (`349-351`, over `Signatures::holds_modal`, `81-83`), before it reads the box. The grid is
the visible screen only (vt100 scrollback 0, `285`). So a transcript row quoting a label refuses every send until
later output scrolls it off. `pause` / `release` redraw nothing, a fresh launch clears the grid, and `--continue`
redraws the quote, which matches every measured fact of 2026-11-19T10:22Z. `input_box_up` (`105-108`) carries the
same «no row holds a modal label» clause.

**What a real modal looks like on the screens viola holds (no start):**
- the trust dialog, recorded on 2.1.287, .288, .302, .325 and .328: its label alone on its row at column 3. The
  recording blanks every other row, so the selector row and the frame are not kept. 2.1.325 and .328 also keep an
  80-char rule on row 1 with no prompt row under it. No box rows stand below the label on any of them.
- the browser-tools offer, on the rig's kept first screens (local, gitignored, 2.1.325 / .328 era): a 70-char top
  rule over a title, `❯` on the cancel row at column 2, the label alone on the next row at column 4, a confirm footer,
  and no box below.
- the imports dialog: no recorded screen at all. It exists only as synthetic unit rows (`screen.rs:1008-1016`): the
  cancel row with `❯`, the label alone at column 3, and an input-box FOOTER literal under it.
- the suite's synthetic browser-tools screen (`tests/support/fake.rs:163-178`) draws the box's OWN rule and prompt

**The candidate discriminators, each with the modal it could miss:**
- **(1) Option shape**: the label row is an option row — indent, an optional selector `❯ `, an optional `N. `, then
  the label ending the row. Every known modal reads standing: trust (recorded, column 3), browser-tools (rig, column
  4; synthetic, column 2), imports (synthetic, column 3), and the fake agent's selected form. Misses: a CLI build that
  puts other text on the label's row, such as a «(recommended)» tail or a shortcut hint. Defeated by: a quote that
  stands alone on its own line. An assistant message's continuation rows are indented 2, so a one-line quote or a
